placeholders.{OWNER}: holder subject; {REF} for an item on the floor or held in reserve
placeholders.{WHERE}: room id when on the floor, else 0
placeholders.{QUEST}: for a reward item: the quest's number

verbs.give S ITEM: write owner := S, expected = my subject
verbs.drop ITEM: write owner := REF, where := my at; targets [item, my sheet]
verbs.take ITEM: an intent; the referee writes owner := me; targets [item, my sheet]
verbs.examine ITEM: read the item, print its design doc
